author: Arhan Canli
claim_boundary: A measurement of what the engine produces from what the lakes store. It changes no lake, no engine and no result; it opens no return path and spends no identity.

classes.DOUBLED: adjusted jump within 15 percent of twice the raw jump: the factor was applied inverted
classes.UNCHANGED: adjusted jump within 15 percent of the raw jump: the split was not applied
classes.UNDETERMINED: no bar on one side of the ex-date

engine_test_convention: tests/unit/test_factors_equity_price.py encodes a 2-for-1 split as ratio 0.5 (old shares per new)
